mentions.name: Transit-first real estate search platform
mentions.description: A real estate search platform that ranked public transit and biking access first, which achieved modest success in Ireland before development on it stopped.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also built a real estate search platform that put public transit and biking first and it achieved a little bit of success in Ireland (not a place with great transit or biking) before I finally had to stop investing time into it.

evidence.value: I also built a real estate search platform that put public transit and biking first and it achieved a little bit of success in Ireland (not a place with great transit or biking) before I finally had to stop investing time into it.
